VisitorSession.title: VisitorSession
VisitorSession.description: Anonymous guest usage session tracked without requiring login so the admin can monitor visitor counts, language preferences, device mix, and story generation usage.

sessionId.description: Unique session identifier generated per browser tab session.

visitorId.description: Pseudonymous persistent visitor identifier stored in localStorage (no PII).

visitNumber.description: Sequential visit number for this browser visitor (1 for first-time visitors).

isReturning.description: Whether this visitor had visited previously.

currentStep.description: Latest page/step reached in the studio flow.

anglesGeneratedCount.description: Number of story angle generations triggered in this session.

breakdownsGeneratedCount.description: Number of full shot-breakdown prompt sets generated in this session.

ttsPlaysCount.description: Number of voiceover story narrations played in this session.

activeDurationSec.description: Approximate active engagement time in seconds.

dayKey.description: UTC/local calendar day string YYYY-MM-DD for daily analytics grouping.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest activity heartbeat or action.

AdminUser.title: AdminUser
AdminUser.description: Authorized administrator document granting dashboard access.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin entry was created.

/visitor_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Write-only for unauthenticated guest sessions; read, list, and delete strictly restricted to verified admins.

/admins/{uid}.description: Admin access registry strictly controlled by verified admin accounts.
